# RecurrencePlotCharacterization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method using recurrence plots (binary matrices of state revisits) to quantify and visualize the spatiotemporal structure of polychronous group activity. Provides a topology-sensitive diagnostic tool for evaluating and tuning neuromorphic network dynamics in TCC/iNEST hardware.
